arguments.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS distinct_players,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN debut IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_debuts,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN debut = '' THEN 1 END) AS blank_debuts,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN final_game IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_final_games,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN final_game = '' THEN 1 END) AS blank_final_games,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN debut <> '' AND strftime('%Y', debut) IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS unparsed_debuts,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN final_game <> '' AND strftime('%Y', final_game) IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS unparsed_final_games,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', debut) IS NOT NULL
                AND strftime('%Y', final_game) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS complete_date_pairs
FROM main.player

arguments.sql:
WITH date_differences AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(strftime('%Y', final_game) AS INTEGER)
            - CAST(strftime('%Y', debut) AS INTEGER) AS years,
        CAST(strftime('%m', final_game) AS INTEGER)
            - CAST(strftime('%m', debut) AS INTEGER) AS months,
        CAST(strftime('%d', final_game) AS INTEGER)
            - CAST(strftime('%d', debut) AS INTEGER) AS days
    FROM main.player
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(
    ROUND(ABS(years), 2)
    + ROUND(ABS(months) / 12.0, 2)
    + ROUND(ABS(days) / 365.0, 2)
), 2) AS average_career_span_years
FROM date_differences
LIMIT 1
